name: Con Dao prison
kicker: Prison camps walked as one site
summary: Walk the camps as one site, then go on to Hàng Dương. The history museum counts nearly 2,000 fighters held. The ministry article counts about 20,000 dead. Both figures stay. The gate hour and the relic ticket are Check on arrival. The park boat fee does not include this visit.
getThere: Walk in town. Confirm the door on arrival.
heroCaption: The camp yard, with cell doors along both sides and the ridge at the end

notice.title: The park fee is not this ticket
notice.body: The scenic-route fee does not include the prison. A ticket desk cites 50,000 VND. The resolution PDF was not opened, so the relic ticket is Check on arrival.

body: You walk a camp system, not one building. The history museum says Governor Bonard signed the founding decision on 1 February 1862. It counts 127 cells, 42 isolation cells, and 504 solitary rooms called chuồng cọp. The same chapter says nearly 2,000 revolutionary fighters were held. The ministry’s 2019 article says tens of thousands were held and about 20,000 died. Both figures stay. After 1975 the prison function ended. In 1979 the site was ranked a national relic with 17 components. Decision 548/QĐ-TTg of 10 May 2012 ranked it a special national relic.

The photograph after the yard is the French tiger-cage range: stone walls, barred doors, and the long cell block behind. The museum chapter dates those cages to 1940, with 120 solitary rooms and 60 open rooms. Phú Hải, signed on its own gate, is the oldest large camp, built in 1862 and rebuilt in solid form in 1896. The other camps the chapter names stay in this entry: Phú Thọ, Phú Sơn, Phú Tường, Phú Phong, Phú An, Phú Bình, Phú Hưng, and the unfinished ninth camp. Chuồng Bò began as a cowshed in 1876 and was later used as cells. The lord’s house has 18,600 square metres of grounds and was the workplace of 53 governors from 1862 to 1975.

The indexed registration extract of 27 December 2024 lists a route through the museum, Phú Tường and the French tiger cages, the lord’s house, Phú Hải, Phú Sơn, Phú Bình, and Phú An, at số 02 Nguyễn Huệ, khu 9. That page timed out, so the slots stay an extract: morning 07:30–11:30 and afternoon 14:00–17:00. Hours are Check on arrival. Skip this if you only wanted the swim. Do not budget the tiger cages as a separate island.

gettingThere: Walk from the town. The indexed extract gives số 02 Nguyễn Huệ, khu 9. The page did not load, so confirm the door. Street minutes were not printed.
Côn Đảo airport, VVCS, is 10 km northeast of town. Road minutes are Check on arrival. Taxi and hire car are the town transport the AIP lists.

admissionNote: A ticket desk cites Resolution 03/2020/NQ-HĐND of 4 August 2020 at 50,000 VND, and 25,000 VND for the half-price group. The resolution PDF was not opened, and no second publisher printed those figures on a page that loaded, so the relic ticket is Check on arrival. This is not the park scenic fee. The ministry says the protected area is more than 110 ha. A desk figure of 110.69 ha was not opened and is not used.
